label: Modal spine Arrival B: the sense of B1's beginning and its connection to the metric Grim Reaper
summary: Target: modal spine stage one, Arrival B premise B1 (8ea0321d), toward STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (b19ffd92) and STMT-GOD-EXISTS; connect the metric Grim Reaper (attempt 5f4e157a, populatedPastsMetricallyFiniteOfPatchwork, conclusion 4365c3c5) to a root route. Spec: specs/modal-spine-metric-beginning-arrival.toml. SENSE FINDING. B1 as typed (PossibleCauseOfContingency.PossiblyBeginsAt) has no fixed sense of beginning: the Scenario has no times, and beginsContingency : World -> Prop is an uninterpreted field. The existing Arrival B theorems (LocalFramePossibleExternalCause.necessaryConcrete, ActualEuclidean.externalNecessaryConcrete) hold for every predicate, including the constant True used by their controls; the prose of DEF-POSSIBLE-CAUSAL-OPPORTUNITY ('stipulated first obtaining') is not enforced. So B1 is neither a first-moment nor a finite-past claim; its content and that of B2 depend on the supplied predicate. A finding of this attempt: before it, Arrival B concluded the Scenario statement 679eb3f7, not b19ffd92, and B1 and B2 did not reach the GOD_4 root at all. DISAMBIGUATION. BEGINS (dc40914a): BEGINS_1, every populated moment of the history has a past with a first moment (FirstMomentBeginningAt); BEGINS_2, every populated moment has a past of finite duration on the clock, read with CLOCK_1 (FiniteDurationBeginningAt; FLRW-shaped open-below finite pasts satisfy it); BEGINS_3, the supplied Scenario predicate (ContingencyBeginsAt), now linked from 8ea0321d and df89f0d2. Each sense has its own definition and Lean declaration. RESULTS (TruthCore.Causality.MetricBeginningArrival). (1) possiblyBeginsFiniteDurationOfMetricallyFinite (ebf324e3): metrically finite populated pasts (4365c3c5) and possible population (faa1ff28: some accessible history has a contingent concrete thing present at some moment) give B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (951a2235); non-transcription, composing the Reaper result through its conclusion statement. (2) possiblyFiniteDurationOfFirstMoment (8da13191): in linear time B1 in sense BEGINS_1 (b58d1aac) strengthens B1 in sense BEGINS_2 (registered strengthens relation, sense bridge BEGINS_1 to BEGINS_2); strict by control 2. (3) necessaryConcreteOfFiniteDurationBeginning (22dbb73a): Euclidean access at the selected world (1b1462e6), actual reflexivity, B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 (256b5bab) give b19ffd92; declared an instantiation transcription of ActualEuclidean.externalNecessaryConcrete at the Scenario whose predicate is BEGINS_2. (4) possiblyNecessaryOfFiniteDurationOpportunity (8f77abb0): B1 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 already give possibly a necessary concrete individual (d2d7cf61), with no frame premise; declared an instantiation of ExternalCandidateNecessity. (5) controls (54bf1664): in the integer history pivot possible population holds and B1 in sense BEGINS_2 fails (the metric premise is needed); in openBelow (positive reals) B1 holds in sense BEGINS_2 and not BEGINS_1, B2 in sense BEGINS_2 fails for the empty cause relation, and no concrete individual is necessary at either world (B1 and the frame do not give the conclusion without B2; the spaced Reaper premises hold there by MetricGrimReaper control 2); in openBelowSource the whole bundle and the conclusion hold. Computed frontier-diff (root GOD_4 exists): the spaced Reaper premises 37d4e072 and bb7b476c, possible population faa1ff28 and B2 in sense BEGINS_2 256b5bab now reach the root (bare); support alternatives added for 4365c3c5 and 951a2235. HOW MUCH IT BUYS. The Reaper reaches the root only through Arrival B, and there the decisive premise is B2: with B1 in the same sense it contains the possibility of a necessary concrete individual (result 4), so a rival who denies that possibility rejects B2 in sense BEGINS_2 outright; the arrival does not discriminate against that rival. B1 in sense BEGINS_2 is the cheap premise: given the Reaper conclusion every accessible populated history is a BEGINS_2 history (analyst observation from the definitions, not registered), so B2's antecedent is then just possible population; and on the principle L (solutions of accepted laws are metaphysically possible), on which the FLRW objection to begun pasts rests, a possible populated FLRW history gives B1 in sense BEGINS_2 directly without any Reaper premise (not formalized). What the Reaper adds is interpretive: it makes the possible populated histories beginnings in a definite metric sense, the sense in which a causal-opportunity principle for beginnings would apply to them. Arrival A still cannot use the metric conclusion (its bridge from metrically finite to begun pasts is the one FLRW denies). OBJECTION AND WARRANT AUDIT (Substantive Objection Standard). B1 in sense BEGINS_2: no substantive objection identified; no recorded argument that every possible populated history has a metrically infinite past; the clock choice remains exposed to the open Misner-type objection (under ln t an FLRW past is infinite), which targets CLOCK_1, not this derivation; the Reaper route inherits the undercutting objection to spaced patchwork recorded in attempt 5f4e157a. Possible population: no substantive objection identified (it follows from actual contingent presence under actual reflexivity, not registered). B2 in sense BEGINS_2: no positive warrant is on file; attempt 169b007b records that ordinary causal aptitude and recombination of contingent producers do not supply an external producer. An objection specific to the finite-duration sense (no first moment, so nothing to be the first effect) has no target in the typed premise: the totality-cause relation carries no temporal constraint, so the cause need not precede any moment; no substantive objection identified. The brute-beginning rival survives as a model (control 2), which shows B2 is needed, not that it is false. Nothing is attributed to any author. No premise is established.
blocker: B2 in sense BEGINS_2 (256b5bab) is OPEN and has no positive warrant on file; it carries the possibility of a necessary concrete individual (8f77abb0), so the connection does not discriminate against a rival who denies that possibility. The spaced Reaper premises remain OPEN under the undercutting objection of attempt 5f4e157a. Next tests: a causal-opportunity principle restricted to beginnings whose warrant does not already contain possible necessary being (for example one quantifying over possible contingent producers and their aptitudes, as attempt 169b007b discusses), or a metric counterpart of Arrival A's inert-emptiness step that needs no empty moment; register the implication from L-style FLRW possibility to B1 in sense BEGINS_2 if L is formalized.
